**Finding: deviation (RENEWAL)** — Article IV, ¶p0049.

The only renewal language in the agreement lets the Licensor unilaterally extend the 36-month Initial Period by seven years, with no opt-out, notice window or renewal price protection for us. That is walk-away territory (vendor-controlled multi-year renewal), and it conflicts with sub-clauses II and III of the same article, which contemplate extension only by mutual written agreement.

Redline (validated, preferred level): renewals become successive 12-month periods by mutual written agreement, with renewal fee increases capped at the lesser of CPI and 3%. Fallback offered in the comment: 12-month auto-renewal with a 30-day (up to 60-day) opt-out.
